note: Re-judged 2026-11-20 by an independent agent after a positive test was added and the operator-discard case was re-tagged negative only. RFC 4301 Section 6: "Disposition of non-error, ICMP messages (that are not addressed to the IPsec implementation itself) MUST be explicitly accounted for using SPD entries." The pair is now two tests with opposite outcomes, closing the earlier finding (one assertion wearing two hats). Positive, TestRFC4301OperatorBypassForwardsTransitEchoInClear: under `unmatched discard` with no Child SA, a transit Echo Request (not addressed to Ze) is first sent in each forwarding direction with no operator entry and must not be forwarded, so the catch-all decides it; a both-direction operator BYPASS for ICMP, accepted by verifySPDOrder, installed through installSPDPolicies and read back from the kernel (transitWantInstalled, which also requires a forward policy), then carries a second Echo Request in each direction, observed on the egress link in clear. The only change between the two observations is the entry, so the entry is what decides. Negative, TestRFC4301ForwardedICMPErrorUnderOperatorDiscardMapsToReturnSA, Echo case: an operator out DISCARD for ICMP covering the Echo, with an in BYPASS admitting it at the forward check whose OUT transit gate (spdTransitPolicies) would otherwise carry it in clear, yields XfrmOutPolBlock +1 and no copy at the peer protected or in clear; removing or mis-ranking the discard turns it red. Both claims name the IPv4 prefixes they exercise, so neither over-claims. Residual, not a defect found: the cases are IPv4 and ICMP type ANY; Section 6 says "The discussion in this section applies to ICMPv6 as well as to ICMPv4", and no transit ICMPv6 non-error message is exercised, though nothing ICMP-specific in Ze's SPD entry path distinguishes protocol 58 from 1 here. Record finding: every 6-1 record breaks spdTransitPolicies by replacing its body with a panic, which proves the tests reach the producer and nothing about which disposition they discriminate; the two records on TestRFC4301ForwardedICMPErrorUnderOperatorDiscardMapsToReturnSA include a positive one for a polarity that unit no longer claims.
